definitions.explanation: The act of separating or saying goodbye; a departure from someone or something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{別|わか}れ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{辛|つら}かった→辛い：01112_tsurai⟧。
examples.english: Parting with my friend was painful.

examples.japanese: {別|わか}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧⟦をした→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.notes: {別|わか}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧ = farewell greeting

examples.japanese: ⟦{出会|であ}い→出会い：03445_deai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あれば→ある：00006_aru⟧{別|わか}れ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Where there are meetings, there are also partings.
examples.notes: A common saying about the nature of relationships

examples.japanese: ⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧⟦での→で：00502_de⟧{別|わか}れ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}しても→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦{慣|な}れない→慣れる：00870_nareru⟧。
examples.english: No matter how many times I experience it, I can never get used to saying goodbye at the airport.

examples.japanese: ⟦{卒業式|そつぎょうしき}→卒業式：05584_sotsugyoushiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧、⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{別|わか}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{惜|お}しんだ→惜しむ：09610_oshimu⟧。
examples.english: On graduation day, the teacher and students shed tears, reluctant to part.
examples.notes: {別|わか}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{惜|お}しむ→惜しむ：09610_oshimu⟧ = to be reluctant to part

notes:
{別|わか}れ is the noun form of the verb ⟦{別|わか}れる→別れる：01113_wakareru⟧ (to part, to separate). It carries emotional weight, suggesting sadness or significance — stronger than a simple goodbye.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {別|わか}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{告|つ}げる→告げる：11808_tsugeru⟧: to bid farewell
- {別|わか}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧: parting words
- {別|わか}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧: farewell greeting
- {別|わか}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{惜|お}しむ→惜しむ：09610_oshimu⟧: to be reluctant to part
- ⟦{永遠|えいえん}→永遠：01873_eien⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{別|わか}れ: eternal parting (euphemism for death)
- ⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{別|わか}れ: tearful farewell

CULTURAL NOTE:
Parting is a significant theme in Japanese culture, especially at ⟦{卒業式|そつぎょうしき}→卒業式：05584_sotsugyoushiki⟧ (graduation ceremonies) and ⟦{送別会|そうべつかい}→送別会：16080_soubetsukai⟧ (farewell parties). The saying ⟦{出会|であ}い→出会い：03445_deai⟧⟦があれば→ある：00006_aru⟧{別|わか}れ⟦もある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (where there are meetings, there are also partings) reflects a Buddhist-influenced acceptance of impermanence.
